overview.text: Arcane is an animated fantasy-action series based on Riot Games’ League of Legends, created by Christian Linke and Alex Yee and produced with French animation studio Fortiche. Its central story follows sisters Vi and Powder, who later becomes Jinx, as they are drawn onto opposing sides of conflict between Piltover, a prosperous city, and Zaun, its struggling undercity. By focusing on the sisters’ changing relationship and the unequal, tense bond between the cities, the show expands the game’s fictional world through character-driven storytelling. Arcane also became the first streaming series to win the Television Academy’s Outstanding Animated Program Emmy, in 2022.

key_facts.text: The series is based on League of Legends; Christian Linke and Alex Yee created it, with Fortiche Production handling animation.
Vi and Powder are sisters; Powder later becomes Jinx, and their changing relationship is central to the story.
The story’s main setting is the contrast between Piltover and Zaun, whose conflict puts the sisters on opposing sides.
The Television Academy lists Arcane as the 2022 Outstanding Animated Program winner; Netflix describes it as the first streaming series to win that award.
